title: Talk to an expert
intro: Registered dietitians, doctors, psychologists and fitness coaches, by video, voice or chat. Book a time that suits you.
emergency: Not for emergencies. If you need urgent help, call 112 or go to the nearest hospital.
empty: No experts match those filters. Try another language or day.
noSlots: No times in the next two weeks

expectItems: A private {{minutes}}-minute consultation by video, voice or chat.
Time to talk through your goals, your health check results and your questions.
A short written summary and next steps afterwards, saved to your records.
profile.verifiedNote: Living Dose checks every professional's registration before they join, and regularly afterwards.

book.title: Book a consultation

prepare: Find a quiet, private place with good signal.
For video, test your camera and microphone, and charge your phone.
Have your medicines and any recent test results nearby.
Write down the questions you'd like to ask.
